experimental_design.evidence: inferred: A cold-induced conformation of CI:III2 (termed type 2) was identified with a ~25 rotation of CIII2 around its inter-dimer axis, shortening inter-complex Q exchange space, and exhibiting different catalytic states which favor electron transfer.

number_of_fractions.evidence: The peptide mixture was fractionated into a total of 96 fractions, which were consolidated into 24 super- fractions, of which all 24 fractions were analyzed.

technology_type.evidence: Isolated mitochondria contanining MAMs were resuspended in 200 EPPS, pH 8.0, 8M urea and 1% SDS.
